Total number of questions — 20
Adverse impact of import of
agricultural products
*461. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the agricultural
products imported during the last three
years;
(b) whether Government have
conducted any survey to assess the adverse
impact of such imports on the domestic
growers/producers;
(c) whether it is a fact that this import
is driving farmers to commit suicide in
various parts of the country; and
(d)  if so, the steps taken by Government
to protect Indian farmers?
Export of Indian Coffee
*462. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Coffee Board has
engaged any consultants in order to regain
its lost market;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
boost export of Indian Coffee?
Implementation of NREG Act
*463. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether implementation of the
National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
(NREGA) has started;
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the mechanism and frequency of periodical
monitoring of its implementation in the
targeted States by Government;
(c) the details of the persons seeking
jobs under NREGA and those duly given
jobs in the course of the first two months
of implementation of the Act, State-wise;
and
(d) the nature of problems, if any,
witnessed commonly/severally by the
States in implementation of the NREGA
during the initial period?

DRDO global tie-ups in aerospace
*464. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Defence
Research and Development Organization
(DRDO) proposes to have global tie-ups
in aerospace;
(b) if so, the details and present status
thereof; and
(c) what is Government's action plan to
evolve a road map for preparing the country
to meet the demands of network-centric
warfare of the future?
Withdrawal of army from valley
†*465. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are in favour
of complete withdrawal of army from the
valley;

by the Deputy Chief of Army in
'Sadbhavana Abhiyan' differ with
Government's view; and
(c) whether large scale arrests of
terrorists and the above statement would
not create fear among the local citizens?
Foreign investment in single branded
retailing
*466. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether in order to permit FDI in
retail trade Government have decided to
allow foreign investment in single branded
retailing outlets and to liberalise the foreign
investment rules across sectors;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the number of branded foreign
retailing outlets set up so far, sector-wise?
NGOs cooperation in manufacturing
of military equipments
†*467. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
take cooperation of the Non-Governmental
Organizations in the manufacturing of
military equipments and ammunition for
the army;
(b) if so, the names of the industrial
houses/organizations being selected for this
purpose; and
(c) the criteria therefor?
Employment opportunities in public
and private sector units
*468. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that employment
opportunities in the public and private
organized sector units have come down
from 277.89 lakhs in 2001 to about 260
lakhs in 2004;
(b) whether it is also a fact that lakhs of
people are affected due to globalization,
liberalization and privatization;
(c) what are the details of the employees
retrenched during the above period in public
sector, year-wise; and
(d) how Government are planning to
increase the number of employment
opportunities, apart from Employment
Guarantee Scheme?

Industries in Maharashtra
*469. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the States doing well on the
industrial/manufacturing front;
(b) whether it is a fact that the industrial
sector in Maharashtra is on the decline;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor and
whether Government are devising any
package for the benefit of Maharashtra
where industries are suffering due to several
problems; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Recruitment of women in police
forces
*470. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal under
the active consideration of Government to
abolish recruitment of women in Police in
the country;
(b) if so, whether some State
Governments have also approached the
Central Government in this regard, and if
so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when the recruitment of women
in police force would be completely
stopped and if not, the reasons therefor?
AEZ proposals from Karnataka
*471. SHRIMATI PREMA CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of
Karnataka has sent any proposals for
setting up of Agri-Export Zone for aromatic
medicinal and dye plants, grapes, mango,
lime, pomegranate and potatoes;
(b) if so, whether any assistance has
been given from Government of India; and
(c) if not, by when the proposal would
be considered?
Increase in exports
*472. SHRI DARA SINGH:
SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that exports from
India are likely to exceed $100 billion during
the fiscal 2005-06 as it continued to register
double-digit growth at about 20 per cent;
(b) if so, what has been its growth during
the last three years, year-wise;
(c) what new initiatives Government
have taken to actively engage State
Governments in promoting India's foreign
trade besides a series of new measures to
simplify procedures and enhance
competitiveness of exports; and
(d) the target set for 2005-06 and
2006-07?
Development of textile and apparel
production centres
*473. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to develop 25 textile and
apparel production centres in the country;
(b) if so, by when these centres would
be built and the locations thereof;
(c) what would be the functions of these
centres;
(d) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to merge the two existing schemes,

146
Textile Centres Infrastructure Development
Scheme (TCIDS) and Apparel Parks for
Exports (APE); and
(e) if so, the reasons therefor?
Contribution of EPF
†*474. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA : Will the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many
industrial institutions and firms are facing
criminal charges on account of not making
payment of employee's contribution to the
Employees Provident Fund;
(b) if so, the details of such firms and
institutions together with the amount not
subscribed by them;
(c) the action taken by Government in
this regard; and
(d) whether it is also a fact that some
Government officers are in collusion with
the defaulting firms, and if so,
Government's reaction thereto?
Review of Indo-Singapore
Comprehensive Economic Cooperation
Agreement
*475. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and Singapore
reviewed the Comprehensive Economic
Cooperation Agreement to identify the areas
in which the two countries can improve
bilateral trade and investment flow;
(b) if so, the points discussed during
the meeting held on March 4, 2006;
(c) whether all issues have been settled;
and
(d) to what extent Indo-Singapore
agreement relating to trade in goods, services
and investment has been finalized?
Hike in cement prices
*476. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
during the last three months cement prices/
hiked upto 40 per cent;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether any regulatory authority or
any institution is there to control the prices
rates of cement;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Funds under SGRY
†*477. SHRI KANJIBHAI MAGAN-
BHAI PATEL: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that the funds provided in
Scheduled Areas of Scheduled Tribes under
Sampoorna Gramin Rozgar Yojana (SGRY)
are not adequate; and
(b) if so, the action being taken to
increase the funds?
Suicide by police personnel

LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of police personnel who
committed suicide on account of stress of

Plan of LeT to attack BARC/Mumbai
city
*479. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI :
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Lashkar-e-
Taiba terrorists are planning to target
Bhabha Atomic Research Centre at
Mumbai by using suicide bomber and plan
to destroy Mumbai city by using F-16 and
Mirage-5 bombers;
(b) whether it is a fact that suicide
mission terrorists are planning their bomber
plan with Atomic Energy Centre itself; and

Protection of domestic growers of
Virginia tobacco
*480. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plans
to protect domestic growers of Virginia
tobacco from low-cost imports;
(b) the details of the demand made by
various farmer groups in this regard; and
(c) what steps Government propose to
take to protect tobacco farmers to ensure that
they are not put into economic crisis by weak
import policies and low import tariffs?

Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
